title: fix(deploy-check): soft-fail on deploy-blocked (fleet-ops#768)
body:
## What

fleet-deploy-check is the 2-min tight-cadence merge-to-live gate (fleet-ops#468).

## Fix

Wrapper now logs LOUD DEPLOY-CHECK-FAILED for visibility and returns 0 on deploy-blocked.

Closes the loop. Closes fleet-ops#768.
